author: Donald Zrebiec
title: She Was Here: Finding My Grandmother After Willard
content:
I

 often mention that I was the only one of Catherine Smoral’s grandchildren to see her alive. I was six years old, and the visit to Willard State Hospital was a bad experience for all four of us who were there: my mother Anna, my Uncle Tony, me, and my grandmother Catherine. The three of us who came from Syracuse were all shocked at the physical and mental condition of our mother and grandmother. Our visit upset her, and we spent a very short time there before being asked to leave.


My grandmother was born in Poland in 1884. She emigrated to the U.S. in 1900, and in 1902 she married my grandfather, Karol Smoral. They were married at Sacred Heart, a beautiful Polish church that still stands on the west side of Syracuse. They were a happy couple who went on to have nine children, a happy and healthy brood. Karol bought his own home on Morgan Avenue, and a family burial plot at Sacred Heart Cemetery not far from it. In the early 1920s, disaster struck the household.


I received, I believe from Ancestry.com, a copy of an article from the Syracuse Herald from the early 1920s. This is how it read:


SMORAL FAMILY WOES CULMINATE IN COMMITTAL OF EIGHT TO INSTITUTIONS. Mother and Son Are Sent to Willard. Six Younger Children to Various Orphanages. Father Died in December.


Mrs. Catherine Smoral and son Stephen, 15, were committed to Willard. Until death delivered its first blow at 107 Morgan Avenue, the family of Karol had something resembling happiness. The mother, who had been in a State Hospital before, had been returned to her family apparently cured. Stephen, then the oldest child, was of working age at 16. The children were sufficiently nourished and progressing. When Karol died, his wife became melancholic, and their son Stephen succeeded her as both mother and father of the household. The burden of being both mother and father broke him down. An investigator from the International Institute found the family nearly destitute. The son Stephen had been employed in a laboratory, but conditions for work were made impossible.


Awaiting his transfer to his new home, Chester drugged himself [he was a year and a half old at the time] with some chocolate he was given by someone in the courtroom. He smeared himself with the chocolate . . . Welfare workers are working to find him a home in a Polish family. The four girls had been all dressed up for the trip and were quiet. They had been weeping.


No matter how many times I see or read this article, I get emotional. It encapsulates the reason I wrote the book. I have a lot of trouble with it. First, it is inaccurate, and it tries to make those kids into clowns instead of marveling at their courage. Perhaps what bothers me most is the comment early on that the family had “something resembling happiness.” Who in the hell was that reporter to make a judgment like that? That’s my family he is talking about. How did they make this family tragedy a front-page story, and why did they try to turn it into some semi-comic farce? Every time I reread it, I would like to hit that reporter right in the face. But at the time, maybe mental illness and sudden death were subjects for fun and light-heartedness.


His name was never Chester. His given name was Vincent, and his nickname was Chet. I get upset about his “drugging himself” on chocolate when he was a year and a half old. He may never have had chocolate until that day. I always admired him. He became a scholarship athlete who went to college and was the first member of the Smoral family to graduate, and he was an excellent role model for his children.


Then there is the way they described the girls, all dressed up but weeping. Those girls were about six, eight, and ten years old. They had just lost both parents, their home, and probably each other, and the newspaper noticed that they had been crying. This was my family they were talking about. They should have had the sense to commend those children for holding up so well. A lot of children could not have, and I wouldn’t have blamed them. This article encapsulates all of the sadness in this whole story.


Zrebiec family photo. Courtesy of Don Zrebiec


I got over the visit to Willard pretty quickly. My picture of my grandmother faded after a short time, and I became immersed in the process of growing up. I talked to my mother about her mother at times, but she always seemed reluctant to go very deep in these conversations and often changed the subject. She had been hurt by …

content:

Es ist kaum 65 Jahre her, da war es absolut üblich, in der anarchistischen Literatur Analysen der Institutionen zu lesen, in denen sich die verschiedenen Formen der Herrschaft manifestierten. Wenn man beispielsweise über die Unterdrückung der Frauen schrieb, dann wurden die Familie und die Ehe untersucht und bloßgestellt. Wenn die Unterdrückung von Vergnügen und der Freude des Lebens zur Diskussion stand, dann wurden Religion und Gesetz ins Visier genommen. Der institutionelle Rahmen, in dem sich diese Gesellschaft abspielt wurde als Quelle der Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung wahrgenommen.

Es scheint so, als wäre dieser institutionelle Rahmen in jüngerer Zeit größtenteils vergessen worden zu sein. Von den verschiedenen Institutionen, in die unser entfremdetes kreatives Potenzial zu unserem Nachteil akkumuliert wurde, scheinen nur noch der Staat und das Kapital (und gelegentlich die Technologie) in einem bedeutenden Ausmaß Erwähnung zu finden und selbst diese werden häufig mehr als Geisteszustände, denn als konkrete soziale Institutionen behandelt. So entdecken wir beispielsweise, dass Anarchist*innen gegen Staatlichkeit (was auch immer das sein soll) sind, anstatt gegen den Staat. Auf diese Weise kann etwa ein Bookchin behaupten, gegen Staatlichkeit zu sein, während er den altertümlichen griechischen Stadt-Staat als Modell für seine demokratisierte Version der „Anarchie“ bewirbt.

Jede andere Form der Unterdrückung wird ebenfalls zu einem „-ismus“ (Rassismus, Sexismus, usw.) oder schlimmerem (Homophobie impliziert beispielsweise eine psychologische Störung, die einer Behandlung bedarf, anstatt einer sozialen Repression, die nach Revolte verlangt). Natürlich verleugnen wir nicht die Realitäten der Ideologien der Bigotterie und ihrer Durchdringung der Gedanken und Gefühle der Ausgebeuteten und Unterdrückten. Aber ohne ein Verständnis des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung und Herrschaft ist es nicht möglich zu verstehen, wie die herrschende Klasse diese Ideologien dazu nutzt, diejenigen zu spalten, die sie ausbeutet.

Selbst die anscheinend Radikalsten (weil ihre Rhetorik am extremsten ist) innerhalb des anarchistischen Millieus entgehen dem nicht. Die von primitivistischen und antizivilisatorischen Kreisen kommende Kritik richtet ihre verbalen Angriffe allzu häufig gegen eine nebulöse, schlecht definierte Zivilisation. Gewiss klingt „Für die Zerstörung der Zivilisation“ radikal. Meiner eigenen Definition gemäß stimme ich damit sogar überein. Aber meiner Definition nach ist Zivilisation nicht irgendeine nebulöse, weitestgehend mentale Kategorie, die dem Rationalismus oder dem westlichen Denken oder welcher unerwünschten Denkweise auch immer entspringt; sie ist ein Netzwerk konkreter sozialer Institutionen, die ich in meinem Alltag konfrontiere: Staat, Wirtschaft, Religion, die Familie, technologische Systeme, und so weiter, allesamt sehr reale Entitäten, die nicht von Gedankenspielen beseitigt werden werden.

Und genau hier tappt die derzeitige Tendenz in eine Falle. Wenn eine Analyse des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung, Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung vergessen wird, dann tritt Therapie an die Stelle von Revolution. Wir sind dann gezwungen, uns mit den pathetischen, weinerlichen Geständnissen eines Chris Crass zu beschäftigen oder auch der schlechten Popkultur-Psychologie der Autor*innen des Textes „Stick it to the Manarchy“ (wobei schon der Gebrauch eines Begriffs wie „manarchy“ ein sicheres Zeichen dafür ist, dass jemand nichts hörenswertes zu sagen hat), die versuchen ihren „Sexismus“, „Rassismus“, „Homophobie“ und „Klassismus“ abzulegen, die nicht länger irgendwelche Ideologien der Bigotterie sind, sondern niedere mentale Krankheiten, unter denen die selbsternannten „Privilegierten“ aller Klassen leiden.

Jede*r ernsthafte revolutionäre Anarchist*in muss sehen, dass das nur eine weitere List der Feiglinge und jener ist, die ein Interesse an der Aufrechterhaltung der herrschenden Ordnung haben, die eigentliche Entscheidung darüber, auf wessen Seite sie im Kampf gegen diese Gesellschaft stehen, aufzuschieben. Diejenigen von uns, die es mit der Zerstörung der gegenwärtigen Welt ernst meinen, um unsere Leben selbst zu gestalten, haben keine Zeit für diese selbstgerechten Gedankenspielereien, die so sehr an Selbsthilfegruppen erinnern („Mein Name ist … …

title: Карл Юджин Строд - Стремление учиться
content:
Автор

: Карл Юджин Строд

Название

: Стремление учиться

Дата

: 2021

Дополнительная информация

: «The Tendency to Learn» — Carl Eugene Stroud

Переведено для

https://t.me/black4red

Источник

: Переведено и скопировано 28.10.2026 с https://anarchistpedagogies.net/resources-en/the-tendency-to-learn


 Сегодня революционная борьба страдает от недостатка способностей на индивидуальном, организационном и социальном уровнях. Нашим крупнейшим социальным движениям, как и нашим самым страстным индивидуальным усилиям необходим милитантский импульс, способный стратегически соединять разрозненные действия. Милитантность позволяет массовым движениям испытывать обоснованную гордость и ощущать свою причастность к наиболее успешным революционным действиям. Она также даёт активному меньшинству чёткую цель и место в формировании социальной силы. Однако стойкая милитантность — это акт свободы, но сегодня большинство людей оказываются «втянуты» в неё не из сознательного выбора, а в силу обстоятельств. Мы, люди, борющиеся за социальную революцию, хотим иметь возможность самим решать, как развивать нашу милитантность. Мы требуем возможности сознательно участвовать в милитантской практике, поскольку так революционный потенциал наших движений будет обеспечен свободой людей.


 И всё же, даже при наличии свободы выбрать милитантскую деятельность остаётся вопрос:


 Куда революционерам направить свои усилия, чтобы их деятельность была связана с той реальностью, в которой в конечном счёте будет жить народ, пробуждала в людях чувство субъектности в Истории и принятие ответственности за этичность своих действий в настоящем?


 Наш ответ следует искать во взрослом образовании, которое представляет собой особенно благоприятную почву для долгосрочного участия в судьбе народных движений. Людям всегда будет необходимо учиться. Поэтому мы предлагаем создать, поддерживать и защищать революционное образовательное направление, которое станет местом встречи и обмена опытом для людей, стремящихся учиться и учить других, — в том числе членов сообщества, активистов, организаторов, диссидентов и милитантов.


 Стремление учиться, которое обычно связывают с молодёжью, новичками, студентами и теми, кому недостаёт опыта, не следует отвергать как стихийную форму организации. Нередко люди, «научившись», переходят к «действиям»: применяют полученные знания, но покидают пространство обучения, в котором они развивали свои способности, не заботясь о том, чтобы сохранить прочную связь с его методами и целями.


 Однако мы настаиваем на том, что это пространство нуждается в целенаправленной защите, если оно должно оказывать долговременное влияние на социальные преобразования. Прежде всего, защита этого пространства со временем будет способствовать коллективному становлению милитантов, которые смогут использовать общий образовательный опыт как основу для единой стратегии и политической программы. Кроме того, сохранение этого пространства будет способствовать пониманию значимости милитантов в социальной борьбе и осознанию того, насколько милитантность необходима для успеха революционных движений.


 Стремление учиться должно выполнять две функции: с одной стороны, служить пространством, где люди получают инструменты и обретают сообщество, необходимые для становления милитантами; с другой — знакомить более широкое сообщество с понятием милитантности и её теорией. Таким образом, наша цель едина, но включает два самостоятельных аспекта, которые необходимо развивать одновременно:


 Мы должны создать образовательное пространство для становления милитантов, а наше регулярное участие в его жизни должно обеспечивать надёжные пути как к милитантской деятельности, так и обратно — к образованию.


 Таким образом, стремление учиться станет пространством, где люди с большим и меньшим опытом смогут встречаться и учиться друг у друга.


 При столь ясных целях нас, несомненно, будут оценивать по нашим же критериям — приверженности делу и стойкости. Ясное определение того, что представляет собой стремление учиться, сможет воплотиться в жизнь лишь благодаря нашей приверженности ему, а его эффективность можно будет оценить лишь по тому, насколько долго оно сохраняется и насколько верно остаётся своим целям.

En svensk förf. Fredrik Lindholm, har någon gång år 1909 "gjort" en skrift om anarkismen, vari han åtagit sig att framställa anarkismens uppgifter. Skriftens huvudsakliga innehåll har blivit ett upprepande av de kungamord och tsarmord, som anarkisterna anklagats för, och i vissa fall väl även utfört.

Den omfattar en period då despotismen, liksom nu i många länder, intog högsätet, då folket var helt rättslöst, då anarkisterna och andra motståndare till stats- och utsugningsmonopolen, behandlades som förbrytare och fördrevs ur landet. Ofta fanns det blott en utväg att väcka uppmärksamhet för dessa ohyggliga förhållanden: Bombens detonation.

Bomben var avsedd eller träffade en herre som i sitt dagliga liv, kanske tanklöst, undertecknat hundratals dödsdomar och förvisningar, som framställde sig vara i kompani med gud, innehade kontroll över alla kanaler till det existerande rättsväsendet, befallde över polis och militär, följaktligen utövade ensam härskarmakt eller representerande sådan makt.

Jag anser mig inte i detta sammanhang ha någon befogenhet att diskutera huruvida det var rätt eller inte. Det skulle bli en alltför vidlyftig avhandling, att framställa vad man talar för och emot i ett sammanhang som detta. Våldet har alltid karaktäriserats som ultima ratio, en sista utväg.

I anarkismens politiska och sociala tankevärld har våldet ingen plats. Såväl de politiska som sociala uttrycksformerna skapar en miljö och atmosfär, som avlägsnar ifrån våldet och främjar inbördes hjälp. Dessa förändringar bygger anarkisterna inte på en sinnets förändring som grundlag, men på fakta som att möjligheterna för det sociala välståndets fördelning uppnåtts och herraväldets och förtryckets förverkligande avlägsnats.

Den fulländning som anarkismens samhällsideal företräder bygger på orsakernas upphävande, orsakerna till våldsmentaliteten.

De invändningar som göras, bygga på helt andra förutsättningar. Den ägande som fruktar för att tjuvar och rånare skola tillägna sig hans egendom, vinkar indignerat bort pratet om att våldet skulle bli överflödigt, noggrant förbiseende att människorna under kommunistiskt-anarkistiska samhällsformer inte ha någon anledning att stjäla eller med våld försvara sig mot stöld.

Militären, som tränat in sin yrkesmentalitet och den fanatiske chauvinisten komma med sina argument! Skola vi inte försvara oss mot utländska fiender?

Här är en fråga som redan nuet borde taga klar ställning till. Finns det någon mening i att försvara sig mot utländska fiender? Vad är det man kan och vill försvara? Marken, naturen, sjöarna, kan inte försvaras, kan inte erövras. Under ett krig kan man däremot förstöra dem. Ja, måste förstöra. Fransmän och belgare förstörde stora delar av sina egna områden, direkt, när tyskarna trängde fram under världskriget, förstörde för att inte tyskarna skulle få nytta av det. Franska och belgiska sprängämnen och volymkulor träffade fransk och belgisk natur - och förstörde kanske lika mycket som "fienden", tyskarna, förstörde.

Krigets mekanisering är ett kapitel som vilar tungt på vågen när det gäller att mäta våldets uppgift i nuet. Förr, när en hord människor dreva mot varandra med pikar och muskedunder, var det hela ett farligt äventyr, som begränsades av vapnens räckvidd. Nu finnes det inte längre någon sådan begränsning. Brand-, gift- och spränggaser ha förverkat varje tanke på "försvar" och mobiliserat angreppstanken som enda möjlighet i en våldskonflikt mellan staterna. De långskjutande kanonerna understryka denna utveckling. Ett krig blir blott ett fruktansvärt förgörande av allt levande.

Enda synpunkten som talar för att med krigets våld lösa de mellanfolkliga konflikterna, är den, att vapenfabrikerna och sprängämnestillverkarna behöva experimentera och måste ha stora dividender.

author: Thomas More
title: A Guide to the Study of Marx - Max Beer
content:
A short study-circle syllabus on Marx by the socialist historian Max Beer. It was published in 1924 by the Labour Research Department as part of its workers’ education series. It covers three areas: Marx’s general views (class society, the relativity of economic and ethical concepts, the Hegelian inheritance), historic materialism, and political economy, from surplus value to the falling rate of profit. It also includes a short biographical sketch of Marx and a suggested order for reading Capital. It ends with G. D. H. Cole’s practical hints for students and class leaders, and period adverts from the Plebs League and the Communist Bookshop. It is a good example of how Marxism was taught to British worker-students in the 1920s.

Labour Research Department, LRD

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

title: Anonym - Die Systeme der Organisation
content:

Es drängt uns, eine Frage von eminenter Wichtigkeit und folgenschwerer Bedeutung unter das Secirmesser der Kritik zu bringen, die Organisationsfrage nämlich. Es ist dieser Gegenstand von weit grösserer Wichtigkeit und Tragweite, als es bei einer flüchtigen Betrachtung den Schein haben mag: denn die Organisation ist das wichtigste Werkzeug des obschwebenden geistigen Riesenkampfes, und ist von grosser Wichtigkeit, ob eben dieses Instrument scharf und spitzig oder schartig und stumpf ist: die Organisation kann aber auch, wenn sie tauglich geformt wird, zur wirksamen Triebkraft, zum zweckdienlichen Sauerteige für die künftige Kulturform werden, sowie andererseits zum Geiste, der beschworen wurde und sich nicht zähmen lässt, wie der von Goethe’s Zauberlehrling.

Dem Wesen nach unterscheiden wir zwei Systeme der Organisation, und zwar den Centralismus und den Föderalismus. Beide sollen nun untersucht werden.

Was zunächst den Centralismus anbelangt, so ist derselbe nichts Anderes wie ein misslungener Abklatsch des despotischen oder absoluten Regierungssystems und zeigt uns, dass nicht allein der Affe, sondern auch der Mensch den Nachahmungstrieb besitzt.

Die Despotie zeigt uns den Centralismus in seiner vollendetsten und ausgebildetsten Form.

Caligula und Nero, Philipp der Zweite von Spanien und Richard III. von England, sowie Ludwig XI. von Frankreich: sie Alle waren Centralisten, die unser Augenmerk fesseln, denn sie waren gross, wenn auch als Tyrannen, wenn auch im Schlechten, sie ragen über die Mittelmässigkeit hoch empor: sie waren Verbrecher an der Menschenwürde, aber sie waren es voll Kraft und Mut, voll Kühnheit und Energie. Was sind aber die Tyrännchen, die sich die Arbeiter durch den Centralismus erzeugen, indem sie sich von Mauldreschern bethören lassen? Erbärmliche Jammergestalten im Vergleiche mit jenen Titanen, deren Andenken glühenden Hass in unserer Seele weckt? Sie sind armselige Zwerge, Liliputaner, und thun wohl daran, sich spreizen und viel und laut von der Redner-Tribüne herunter zu deklamiren und zu kreischen, denn sonst würde man sie gar nicht wahrnehmen. Sie zu verachten, wäre zu viel Ehre für sie, nein, ein mitleidiges Bedauern ist Alles, was ihnen zugewendet werden kann. Sie sind der Vergessenheit geweiht und haben dereinst zwecklos gelebt: das alleinige Ziel ihres Strebens ist das Wohlleben, und dafür treten sie das Heiligste, Erhabenste, die himmlische, ewige Idee in den Kot: sie unterscheiden sich in nichts von einem Mastschwein, das auf nichts denkt wie auf vielen und guten Mais und einen trefflichen Stall, nur erstreben sie beides in einer anderen Form. Ärmliche, kleinliche Menschlein! – Und sie wären vielleicht fähig, ihr ephemeres Sein an die ewige unvergängliche Kette von Ursachen und Wirkungen, Grund und Folge zu knüpfen und ewig zu sein im Erlösungswerk der Menschheit durch ihr fruchtbringendes Wirken, sie wären vielleicht befähigt zu schaffen, so dass sie darin das reinste Glück, ein Gefühl von Seligkeit empfänden im Glücke und Paradieses-Sein Aller, dass sie für künftige Generationen anzubahnen helfen würden.

Der Centralismus vernichtet die individuelle Selbstständigkeit und Freiheit vollständig, wie wir es im despotischen Staat antreffen. Hier ist der Wille des Autokraten Gesetz, dort der Wille des Parteigötzen, den man auf das Piedestal emporhob: der Druck ist ärger noch als im despotischen Staat, denn in einem solchen soll nur eine gesetzwidrige Handlung gerichtet werden; die Spitze der centralistischen Pyramide aber richtet nicht allein die Handlungen, sondern sogar die Meinungen, sie erforscht Herz und Nieren der Menschen wie Jehova, und es sollte auch der Wille solcher Parteigötzen unter Donner und Blitz zeitweilig verkündet werden, wenigstens hätte das Colophonium stärkeren Absatz und die Spängler fänden bei der Anfertigung von Donnerblechen vielleicht lohnende Arbeit.

Treffend bezeichnet ein Engländer den Centralismus, indem er sagt: “Stelle ein Schaf vor die andern und Du hast die Herde fertig.” Ja wohl, eine Herde ist es und weiter nichts, und diese Herde geht hin, wohin der Hammel sie führt, und wenn er in einen Sumpf hineinplumpst, so wandern Alle in den Morast, und thatsächlich stecken gegenwärtig die Bekenner der alleinseligmachenden Sozialdemokratie mit ihrer achtundvierziger Theorie im Schlamme der Reformpolitik und leiden an …

author: Unknown
title: Эррико Малатеста - Наконец-то! Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Наконец-то! Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"

Дата

: 28 сентября 1920

Источник

: Umanità Nova, год 1-й, №187


НАКОНЕЦ-ТО!

Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"


 Наконец-то появился тот, кто говорит ясно!


 До сих пор, когда мы говорили, что то, что социалисты называют

диктатурой пролетариата

, на самом деле есть не что иное, как диктатура некоторых людей, которые с поддержкой партии становятся над пролетариатом и навязывают себя ему, нас за это называли чуть ли не клеветниками.


 Вопреки всякой вероятности и всем установленным фактам утверждалось, что в России разрешена та квадратура круга, которой было бы правительство, действительно представляющее интересы и волю управляемых.


 Соответственно, Москва стала Меккой пролетариата: оттуда исходил свет, а вместе со светом – и категорические приказы относительно идей, которых должны придерживаться, и линии поведения, которой должны держаться те, кто с разрешения вышестоящих хотел называть себя коммунистами.


 Вследствие этого изумительного открытия, сделанного в России, – правительства, созданного по образу народа и для блага народа (или пролетариата, как угодно называть), – всё, что приходило из России, казалось обладающим чудотворной силой; и достаточно было назвать по-русски

советом

 любое собрание или комитет, чтобы он был возведён в верховный фактор революции.


 Но вот очарование разрушено.


 На этот раз не мы раскрываем секрет: мы, анархисты, злоязычные и непочтительные по убеждению. На этот раз это официальная газета Итальянской социалистической партии, до сих пор наиболее авторитетный орган московского слова.


 Это

Avanti!

 от 20-го числа текущего месяца, которая говорит:


 «....

В России при советском режиме Партия действительно направляет всю политику Государства, и вся общественная деятельность как отдельных лиц, так и коллективов подчинена решениям Партии, так что

 В САМОМ ДЕЛЕ ДИКТАТУРА ПРОЛЕТАРИАТА ЕСТЬ ДИКТАТУРА ПАРТИИ И, СЛЕДОВАТЕЛЬНО, САМОГО ЦЕНТРАЛЬНОГО КОМИТЕТА».


 Итак, теперь мы знаем, чего нам следует ожидать: диктатуры Руководящего органа Социалистической партии, или диктатуры нарождающейся Коммунистической партии, или даже диктатуры Д'Арагона и компании!


 Но руководители Социалистической партии, претендующие ввести Диктатуру, должны понять, что это, по крайней мере в Италии, невозможно: невозможно, потому что есть мы, анархисты и синдикалисты.


 Если бы мы находились в том же соотношении сил с социалистами, в каком, возможно, оказались наши товарищи в России, дело было бы простым: диктаторы избавились бы от нас средствами, дорогими всем диктатурам, – виселицами и тюрьмами, – и шли бы вперёд, пока не были бы свергнуты революцией или реакцией.


 Но мы уже сила, с которой необходимо считаться, и мы быстро развиваемся, чему благоприятствуют обстоятельства и то, что

Avanti!

 называет

необузданным темпераментом трудящихся масс

. И мы твёрдо решили не подчиняться.


 Не то чтобы мы верили, что массы всегда правы и что мы хотим всегда следовать за массами в их изменчивых настроениях. У нас есть программа, идеал, который мы хотим привести к победе, и поэтому мы отличаемся от массы, – мы люди определенного направления. Мы хотим воздействовать на массу, подталкивать её по пути, который считаем лучшим; но поскольку наша цель – освобождение, а не господство, мы хотим приучать массы к свободной инициативе и свободному действию.


 Мы верим, что свобода учит свободе и солидарности, и поэтому питаем отвращение к любому авторитарному устройству – как в обществе в целом, так и в любой отдельной партии или объединении.


 Социалисты хотели бы подготовить народ к свободе посредством власти.


 Но если бы, по предположению, которое мы отвергаем, было верно, что для торжества революции и устройства нового общества необходимо сосредоточить в немногих руках государственную власть, если бы было верно, что кто-то обязательно должен командовать, – тогда, пусть социалисты хорошенько поймут, – командовать хотели бы мы и не подчинились бы, разве что силой, командованию того, кто, по нашему мнению, заблуждается.


 Следствием чего было бы то, что революция, совершённая по авторитарным меркам и с диктаторскими целями, неизбежно привела бы в Италии к войне между одними революционерами и другими.


 Этого не хотели бы мы; этого не должны хотеть социалисты.


 Поэтому, оставив в стороне теории и судя о вещах реалистично, социалистам следовало бы отказаться от всяких диктаторских притязаний и принять либертарную …

author: 张皓翔
title: The Dislocation of Vendémiaire—A Commentary on the European Movement Centered on France from September to October 2026
content: From September to October 2026, a movement centered on France provided us with an excellent window for observing the communist cause in the 21st century and also triggered widespread public discussion. Previously, in the form of four separate commentary articles, we published them successively on the libcom platform, unfolding one by one as the movement progressed. These four pieces are not independent theoretical expositions; rather, they develop within the whole theoretical system represented by The Shackles of the Elements, Dance a Dance of Roses on the Land of Rhodes, and The Contemporary Dimensional Ascension of Capital. Now we have found the opportunity to combine them into one volume and add some notes. This is also the first time we have taken theory out of the study and put it to trial on the real field of movement.

author: Unknown
title: Malcolm Archibald - Atamansha
content:
Author

: Malcolm Archibald

Title

: Atamansha

Subtitle

: The life of Marusya Nikiforova

Date

: 2007

Source

: http://nestormakhno.info/english/marusya.htm


Introduction


 The Ukrainian anarchist Maria Nikiforova (1887–1919) has sometimes been compared to Joan of Arc. Like Joan she started from humble origins and, improbably, became a ferocious military commander who was captured and executed by her sworn enemies. And, like Joan, she was a fanatic who pursued her goals in a violent, ruthless fashion.


 But there is no cult of Maria Nikiforova. There are no shelves of books devoted to her life in any language. Although she played a prominent role in the Russian Revolutions of 1917 and the subsequent Civil War, she was virtually expunged from Soviet histories of the period. A biographical dictionary of the Russian Revolution published in the Soviet Union which includes hundreds of names does not mention her, indeed mentions only a couple of dozen women. There are entries on the Bolshevik heroines Alexandra Kollontai, Larissa Reissner, and Inessa Armand but none of these women held independent military commands like Nikiforova.


 There is no scholarly biography of Maria Nikiforova, no historiography of her life which only needs to be updated and possibly reinterpreted. Partly this is because she spent most of her life in the underground: she joined an anarchist terrorist group at age 16 and was really only "above ground" for two years (1917-1919). So there are very few documents to trace her activities and almost no photos. Recognition can be fatal for a terrorist and so it was for Nikiforova in the end. Such accounts of her life which exist are usually found in memoir literature or fiction. Most of these accounts are hostile to Nikiforova and tend to depict her as repulsive and evil.


 Nikiforova was a Ukrainian and her activities in the Russian Revolution and Civil War took place mostly in Ukraine but she has been largely ignored by Ukrainian historians. She was anti-nationalist and, like the Ukrainian anarchist movement in general, she couldn't be assimilated to a nationalist historical perspective.


 Even writers sympathetic to anarchism have, as a rule, neglected her. Although she was closely associated with the famous peasant anarchist Nestor Makhno, books about Makhno scarcely mention her. And yet in 1918 Nikiforova was already famous as an anarchist

atamansha

 (military leader) throughout Ukraine, while Makhno was still a rather obscure figure operating in a provincial backwater. She is absent from the works of Peter Arshinov, Volin, and Paul Avrich. Alexandre Skirda's book on Makhno mentions her but only devotes one paragraph to her in a work of 400 pages. Exceptions to the rule are Makhno himself and his former adjutant Victor Belash. In his memoirs (which only cover 22 months of revolution and civil war) Makhno provides eye-witness accounts of a number of dramatic incidents in which Nikiforova played a leading role. Belash, whose work was rescued from the files of the Soviet secret police, also presents primary source material about her.


 Since the collapse of the Soviet Union there has been tremendous interest in Russia and Ukraine in filling in the "white patches" in their history. Makhno and Nikiforova have benefited from this interest with many books on Makhno being published and a few essays on Nikiforova. The archives have yielded some solid information; for example, Nikiforova's service record exists since she was once a member of the Red Army. Gradually a clearer picture of her life is coming to light and it is possible to establish a reasonably reliable narrative although many ambiguities remain.


 The following sketch of Nikiforova's life is based mainly on secondary sources published in Russian and Ukrainian in the last two decades.


The Young Terrorist


 According to tradition, Maria Grigorevna Nikiforova was born in the Ukrainian city of Aleksandrovsk in 1885, the daughter of an officer who had been a hero of the last Russo-Turkish War. Although this story might help to explain her later martial ardour, it seems unlikely. For even the daughter of an impoverished officer would be unlikely to leave home at 16 to earn a living on our own as Maria did.


 At the turn of the 19th century, Aleksandrovsk was a rapidly industrializing city with a large and militant working class population. Under the conditions of the time there was little paid work for women, but Maria was able to …

In einem Briefe an „Les Temps Nouveaux“ (seinerzeit als „Le Revolté“ von Kropotkin und seinen Freunden gegründet) und in einem zweiten an den bürgerlichen „Temps“, der aber nicht veröffentlicht wurde, nimmt Peter Kropotkin Stellung zur antimilitaristischen Propaganda. Es handelt sich in erster Linie um die Frage, wie sich die Revolutionäre im Falle eines Krieges zu verhalten hätten, und hier nimmt Kropotkin eine gerade entgegengesetzte Stellung zu der antimilitaristischen Richtung, die in letzter Zeit in dem Professor Hèrvé einen energischen Vertreter gefunden. Während diese Letztere für die vollständige Unterdrückung des Militarismus eintritt und selbst im Falle eines „Verteidigungskrieges“ mit dem Streike der Militärpflichtigen antworten will, tritt Ersterer für eine bedingte Beibehaltung des Militärs ein, welches Frankreich, das daran ist, die Grundlagen seiner Gesellschaftsform zu ändern, gegen Angriffe von reaktionären Feinden, unter welchen er hauptsächlich die Deutschen versteht, zu schützen hätte.

Nach unserer Ansicht beruhen die Schlüsse, welche Kropotkin zieht, auf einer allzustarken Unterschätzung der Deutschen, was man ihm aber wahrlich nicht übel nehmen kann; waren es doch die „Germanen“, welche stets wie ein Bleigewicht auf den Gang der internationalen Arbeiterbewegung wirkten. Ganz so pessimistisch denken wir jedoch nicht, vielleicht eben weil wir „Deutsche“ sind, sonst hätten wir es schon längst aufgegeben, unter einer solchen elenden Schafherde Propaganda zu machen.

Nun ist zu sagen, dass, seitdem Russland aufgehört hat, eine stete Bedrohung der freiheitlichen Bewegung in Westeuropa zu sein – was man heute schon mit Bestimmtheit sagen kann – ist es auch Deutschland nicht mehr in dem Masse, weil es an „Rückgrat“ verloren hat. Es wird bald damit genug zu tun haben, die „eigenen Völker“, namentlich die Polen in der Zucht zu halten, dass es sich nicht mehr erlauben kann, ein grosses Volk, das sich zudem noch im Befreiungskampfe befindet, zu unterjochen.

An die Ausführungen von Kropotkin knüpfen sich eine Reihe von Auseinandersetzungen, und es ist auch für uns Schweizer nicht unnützlich, der Sache näher zu treten und sich darüber gründlich auszusprechen, weil es das beste Argument der Bourgeoisie und Sozialdemokraten gegen die antimilitaristische Propaganda ist, dass wir „Freiheiten“ gegen lüsterne Räuber zu verteidigen hätten.

Nachbringend bringen wir die charakteristischsten Ausführungen Kropotkins zum Abdruck, und in Fortsetzung eine Entgegnung von Charles Albert auf dieselben, ebenfalls in „Les Temps Nouveaux“ veröffentlicht.

Dies schreibt unser Peter Kropotkin in einem Briefe an „Les Temps Nouveaux“:

„Wenn Frankreich durch einige Militärmächte überfallen wird, so ist die Pflicht der Revolutionäre nicht, die Arme zu kreuzen und dem eindringenden Feinde freies Spiel zu lassen. Sie ist: die Revolution anzufangen und das Territorium der Revolution zu verteidigen, um sie fortzusetzen.

Die Formel „Streik der Conscrits“ (der militärpflichtigen jungen Leute, D. Ueb.) sagt nicht genug. Sie hat die Unannehmlichkeit, sich auszuschweigen über den eigentlichen Zweck der Propaganda, und gibt Anlass zu falschen Deutungen desselben. Sie sagt nichts von der Revolution und sagt nichts von der Notwendigkeit, in welche die Revolutionäre versetzt werden, diese, jeden Zoll französischer Erde, der sich in Revolution befindet, mit den Waffen in den Händen zu verteidigen gegen die bürgerlichen und kaiserlichen Horden deutscher, englischer oder vielleicht russischer Räuber.“

Und weiter in seinem Briefe an den „Temps“: „Aber wenn die Deutschen Frankreich überfallen, an der Spitze – wie sie es ohne Zweifel machen werden – einer mächtigen Koalition, und die Hände der kleinen Grenzstaaten (Belgien und Schweiz) binden, alsdann wird der Streik der Conscrits nicht genügen. Man müsste machen, was die „Sanscullotes“ im Jahre 1792 getan haben, welche in ihren Sektionen die revolutionäre Kommune vom 10. August konstituierten, das Königtum und die Aristokratie über den Haufen warfen, gewaltsam Steuern von den Reichen erhoben, die Legislative (die gesetzgebende Körperschaft der grossen Revolution) zwangen, das erste wirkliche Dekret zur Vernichtung der feudalen Rechte zu erlassen und deren Zurücknahme durch die Bauern des kommunalen Bodens, und die marschierten, um die französische Erde zu …

author: Stelinsky
title: [Ισπανία] «Είμαστε όλοι Μαρικάρμεν»
content:
Η Μαρικάρμεν Αμπασκάλ, 87 ετών, με αναπηρία, απομακρύνθηκε βίαια με φορείο από το διαμέρισμα της, στο οποίο ζούσε για περισσότερα από 70 χρόνια, στις 23 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026. Η γυναίκα εκδιώχθηκε λόγω αδυναμίας να πληρώσει το υπέρογκο ενοίκιο που της ζητούσαν. Ο πατέρας της Αμπασκάλ νοίκιασε για πρώτη φορά το ακίνητο το 1956 και η ίδια συνέχισε ως ενοικιάστρια μετά το θάνατο των γονιών της, περίοδο κατά την οποία ίσχυε ανώτατο όριο στο ενοίκιο. Η επενδυτική εταιρεία Urbagestión, η οποία αγόρασε το ακίνητο το 2018, αύξησε το ενοίκιο από 500 ευρώ το μήνα σε 2.650 ευρώ. Η εταιρεία προσφέρθηκε αργότερα να το μειώσει στα 1.650 ευρώ, ωστόσο η ίδια εξακολουθούσε να μην μπορεί να το πληρώσει με τη μηνιαία σύνταξή της ύψους 1.350 ευρώ. Σύμφωνα με στοιχεία που δημοσιεύτηκαν στον ισπανικό Τύπο, το 2025 καταγράφηκαν 2.267 εξώσεις στην Κοινότητα της Μαδρίτης. Το γεγονός προκάλεσε έντονες αντιδράσεις και διαδηλώσεις στην Ισπανία, με κόσμο να βγαίνει στους δρόμους ενάντια στην έξωση της 87χρονης.

Κατά τη διάρκεια των διαμαρτυριών, αστυνομικές δυνάμεις συγκρούστηκαν με διαδηλωτές που συγκεντρώθηκαν έξω από το σπίτι της 87χρονης γυναίκας με αναπηρία, προκειμένου να αποτρέψουν την έξωσή της. Η αστυνομία έκανε χρήση δακρυγόνων και πραγματοποίησε επανειλημμένες εφόδους με γκλομπ εναντίον των διαδηλωτών, επιχειρώντας να ανοίξει δρόμο ώστε η δικαστική επιτροπή να μπορέσει να εκτελέσει την εντολή έξωσης.

Στις 28 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026, έπειτα από συμφωνία με την εταιρεία διαχείρισης του ακινήτου, η Μαρικάρμεν επέστρεψε στο σπίτι της, με τον όρο να καταβάλλει μειωμένο ενοίκιο, βάσει νέας σύμβασης, προκειμένου να αποφευχθεί μια σημαντική αύξηση.

Την επόμενη ημέρα, στις 29 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026, η ισπανική κυβέρνηση ανακοίνωσε διάταγμα, το οποίο προβλέπει την αναστολή των εξώσεων έως το 2030 και την αυτόματη ανανέωση των συμβολαίων ενοικίασης, στο πλαίσιο των μέτρων για την αντιμετώπιση της στεγαστικής κρίσης που πλήττει τη χώρα. Παράλληλα, προβλέπει περιορισμούς στις τουριστικές μισθώσεις, όπως αυτές μέσω Airbnb, τις οποίες εκμεταλλεύονται συχνά εταιρείες και επενδυτικά κεφάλαια (funds)*, με αποτέλεσμα να μειώνονται τα διαθέσιμα σπίτια για μόνιμη κατοικία.

Δεν πρέπει, ωστόσο, να ξεχνάμε ότι όλα αυτά συμβαίνουν λίγο πριν από τις κοινοβουλευτικές εκλογές στην Ισπανία. Η ισπανική κυβέρνηση επιχειρεί να αξιοποιήσει την υπόθεση Μαρικάρμεν ως προεκλογικό εργαλείο, σε μια περίοδο που η στεγαστική κρίση προκαλεί έντονο κοινωνικό πρόβλημα.

Στις 7 Οκτωβρίου 2026, η Μαρικάρμεν πέθανε στο νοσοκομείο, χωρίς να έχει προλάβει να επιστρέψει στο σπίτι της. Ο θάνατός της πυροδότησε νέες διαδηλώσεις και αναζωπύρωσε την οργή απέναντι στην κερδοσκοπία και την εμπορευματοποίηση της στέγασης. Την Πέμπτη, 8 Οκτωβρίου, περίπου 20.000 άνθρωποι πραγματοποίησαν μια τεράστια πορεία στο κέντρο της Μαδρίτης, ξεκινώντας από την Πουέρτα ντελ Σολ και καταλήγοντας έξω από το Κοινοβούλιο και το σπίτι της.

Η Μαρικάρμεν φεύγει, αλλά ο αγώνας συνεχίζεται.

Η στέγαση είναι ανάγκη και όχι ευκαιρία για κερδοφορία. Η στέγαση δεν είναι πολυτέλεια ούτε προνόμιο για λίγους! *funds: Τα funds (επενδυτικά ταμεία) είναι ομάδες χρημάτων από πολλούς επενδυτές που συγκεντρώνονται για να αγοράσουν μετοχές, ομόλογα ή άλλα περιουσιακά στοιχεία, με στόχο το κέρδος.

author: Unknown
title: Van'da kar yağışı ulaşımı aksattı: 97 yerleşim yerinin yolu kapandı
content:
Van — Van'da etkili olan kar yağışı nedeniyle 68 mahalle ve 29 mezra yolu, ulaşıma kapandı. Kar yağışı ve olumsuz hava koşulları nedeniyle 6 ilçede taşımalı eğitime 1 gün ara verildi.

Van ve çevresinde dün akşam saatlerinde başlayıp, gece boyunca aralıklarla etkisini sürdüren kar yağışı, hayatı olumsuz etkiledi. Van-Bahçesaray kara yolu, kar ve tipi nedeniyle ulaşıma kapatılırken; Çaldıran, Muradiye, Erciş, Gürpınar, İpekyolu ve Tuşba ilçelerinde taşımalı eğitime 1 gün ara verildi. Yoğun kar yağışı nedeniyle 68 mahalle ve 29 mezra yolu ulaşıma kapanırken, kar kalınlığı yüksek kesimlerde 20, kent merkezinde 10 santimetreyi aştı.

Kar yağışının ardından Van Büyükşehir Belediyesi ve merkez ilçe belediyelerine bağlı ekipler, karla mücadele çalışması başlattı. Ekipler, cadde ve sokaklarda kar küreme ve tuzlama çalışması yürüttü. Van Büyükşehir Belediyesi'nin kent genelindeki karla mücadele çalışmalarını bin 32 personel ve 450 iş makinesiyle sürdürdüğü belirtildi.

author: Unknown
title: Gazze'de göçük altında kalan çadırlarda 5 kişi hayatını kaybetti. Arama kurtarma çalışması sürüyor
content:
Gazze Şeridi'nin orta kesiminde yer alan Deyr el-Belah kentinde yerinden edilmiş Filistinlilerin kaldığı çadırların yağış sonrası meydana gelen göçük altında kalması sonucu biri kadın, 3'ü çocuk 5 kişinin yaşamını yitirdiği bildirildi.

Gazze'deki Sivil Savunma Müdürlüğünün Sözcüsü Mahmud Basal, yaptığı açıklamada, Deyr el-Belah kentinde yerinden edilmiş Filistinlilerin kaldığı çadırların yağmurun taşıdığı kum ve kayaların altında kaldığını söyledi.

Sivil savunma ekiplerinin vatandaşların yardımıyla anında arama kurtarma çalışmalarına başladığını belirten Basal, göçükte ölü ve yaralıların olduğunu ifade etti.

Öte yandan Sivil Savunma Müdürlüğünün Telegram hesabından yapılan açıklamada da Deyr el-Belah'ta göçük altında kalan çadırların enkazından 5 vatandaşın cansız bedenine ulaşıldığı ve arama kurtarma çalışmalarının devam ettiği kaydedildi.

Bölgedeki AA muhabirinin yerel kaynaklardan edindiği bilgiye göre, göçükte yaşamını yitirenler arasında bir kadın ve 3 çocuk bulunuyor.

Gazze'deki hükümetin Medya Ofisinden dün yapılan açıklamada, Gazze Şeridi'nde 12 saat içinde 70 bin çadırın su altında kaldığı, şiddetli yağışlar nedeniyle onlarca duvarın yıkıldığı belirtilmişti.

İsrail’in Ekim 2023'ten bu yana soykırım gerçekleştirdiği Gazze'de binaların yüzde 80'den fazlası yıkıldı veya ağır hasar gördü.

Konutların büyük bölümünün kullanılamaz hale gelmesi nedeniyle Gazze nüfusunun ezici çoğunluğu derme çatma çadırlarda yaşam mücadelesi veriyor. Gazze'de kış mevsiminin bastırmasıyla birlikte yüz binlerce kişinin sığındığı çadırlar şiddetli yağışlar nedeniyle sular altında kaldı.

İsrail, ağırlaşan hava koşullarına rağmen konteyner, barınma malzemesi ve temel insani yardımların bölgeye girişini engellemeyi sürdürürken, ateşkes anlaşması kapsamındaki insani yükümlülüklerini de ihlal etmeye devam ediyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Jorge Macri persigue a los trabajadores de la Ciudad
content:
Jorge Macri persigue a los trabajadores de la Ciudad


Mario Hernandez


 


Trabajadores del subte, de las radios y el Canal de la Ciudad, docentes y médicos residentes y concurrentes de hospitales porteños sufren los atropellos laborales del jefe de Gobierno


 


La Asociación Gremial de Trabajadores del Subterráneo y Premetro (AGTSyP – Metrodelegadxs) emitió un comunicado este lunes 2 de noviembre en el que informó que se encuentra en “estado de alerta” debido a los problemas salariales que atraviesan los trabajadores del sector debido a las prácticas arbitrarias que está desarrollando la concesionaria Emova, específicamente “las reiteradas malas liquidaciones de haberes y descuentos indebidos a trabajadoras y trabajadores desde hace meses”.


Ante esta situación, desde el Sindicato que conduce actualmente Néstor Segovia -tras el fallecimiento el año pasado del histórico dirigente “Beto” Pianelli- advirtieron a la empresa que se abstenga de repetir este accionar en la próxima liquidación de sueldos.


El comunicado fue firmado por Segovia junto a la secretaria de Organización Virginia Bouvet.


Los metrodelegados fueron categóricos al señalar las responsabilidades institucionales y laborales. “Siendo la única responsable de las medidas de autodefensa que resulten de este accionar arbitrario”, sentenciaron, sin detallar cuáles serían las medidas, que pueden incluir asambleas, retención de tareas, liberación de molinetes o paros que afectan directamente el servicio.


 


Liberaron molinetes contra descuentos ilegales y fraude laboral


 


Ocurrió el viernes, de 17:00 a 19:00 en la estación Perú de la Línea A. Trabajadores le exigen a Emova la devolución de salarios ilegalmente descontados y el retiro de las empresas tercerizadas con las cuales la concesionaria violenta el Convenio colectivo de trabajo.


La medida se suma a la de la semana pasada debido a que Emova insiste con su práctica ilegal y persecutoria desconociendo, incluso, fallos judiciales a favor de los trabajadores.


Denuncian que la concesionaria continúa realizando descuentos salariales como forma de amedrentar a los trabajadores y recientemente ha contratado empresas tercerizadas para realizar tareas durante más de 6 horas cuestión que está catalogada por el convenio del sector como insalubre.


Emova con la complicidad del Jefe de Gobierno Jorge Macri y la justicia porteña sigue amedrentando y persiguiendo a los trabajadores del subte. La empresa no reconoce ninguno de los fallos judiciales a favor del reclamo de los trabajadores.


 


Trabajadores del subte liberaron molinetes


 


El miércoles 4 de noviembre desde las 8:00, trabajadores realizaron una apertura de accesos en la estación San Pedrito de la línea A para reclamar la devolución de salarios descontados por la concesionaria. Denuncian que la empresa desconoce fallos judiciales y sostiene una campaña persecutoria acompañada por el Jefe de Gobierno y la justicia porteña.


Comienza un nuevo mes y otra vez la empresa Emova descuenta compulsivamente e ilegalmente salarios, mientras aumenta otra vez el pasaje por arriba de la inflación. Todo con la complicidad de Jorge Macri. Claudio Dellecarbonara, miembro del secretariado del sindicato, explicó que la medida forma parte de la continuidad de un plan de lucha que lleva meses. “Nos vemos obligados a retomar el plan de lucha ya que la empresa concesionaria insiste con este accionar persecutorio y extorsivo”, señaló. También rechazó las acusaciones de Emova contra los trabajadores afectados, a quienes la empresa responsabiliza por supuestos incumplimientos de sus jornadas laborales. “Esta campaña de falacias” busca justificar los descuentos, sostuvo, y remarcó que esas acusaciones son falsas y fácilmente comprobables.


El conflicto se desarrolla en un contexto de creciente criminalización de las protestas gremiales en el subte. El pasado 20 de octubre, una apertura de molinetes en la estación Juan Manuel de Rosas de la línea B terminó con la detención de dirigentes y delegados sindicales. La medida se realizaba en solidaridad con un trabajador suspendido por negarse a extender su jornada laboral más allá de las seis horas diarias. Cuando efectivos de la Policía de la Ciudad ingresaron a los vestuarios para detener al delegado Sebastián Carrizo, Claudio Dellecarbonara y Facundo Heredia intervinieron para defender a su compañero los cuales terminaron siendo detenidos. title: Gastronominin vitrini şeflik, mutfağın gerçeği bol kepçe sömürü
content:
Televizyon programları, MasterChef gibi yarışmalar ve sosyal medyanın büyüttüğü Michelin yıldızlı şeflik hayali gençleri gastronomi eğitiminin olduğu bölümlere yöneltirken, mutfakların arkasında taşeronlaşma, düşük ücret, meslek hastalıkları, iş kazaları, yetersiz beslenme ve güvencesizlik büyüyor.

Gastronomi bölümlerinde şeflik hayali kuran, yarışmalarda şampiyon olup restoran açmayı hedefleyen gençlerin bulunduğu sektörün diğer tarafında ise binlerce kişilik yemek üretimini düşük ücret, uzun çalışma saatleri ve ağır koşullar altında gerçekleştiren mutfak işçileri bulunuyor. Gastronomi dünyasında restoranlara müşteri ve gelir sağlayan ödüllerin arkasındaki mutfakta görünmeyen emeği aşçılarla ve sektörde örgütlü sendika başkanları ile konuştuk.

DİSK/Gıda-İş Genel Başkanı Olcay Ozak, gastronomiye yönelik ilginin televizyon, internet ve sosyal medyanın etkisiyle büyüdüğünü belirterek, gençlerin kendilerini başarılı birer şef olarak yetiştirme hayaliyle bu bölümlere yöneldiğini söyledi. Michelin yıldızı gibi derecelendirmelerin restoranlara müşteri ve gelir sağladığını, ancak bu değeri yaratan mutfak çalışanlarına aynı ölçüde yansımadığını ifade eden Ozak, “Bunların arkasındaki şefler, aşçıbaşılar emeğin asıl sahibidir ama ödül restoran sahibine gider” dedi. “Gastronomi okuyan öğrencilerin çoğu staj adı altında aslında müthiş bir sömürü çarkının içerisine itiliyorlar” diyen Ozak, stajyerlerin denetim ve koruma mekanizmalarından yoksun bırakılmasının sorunları ağırlaştırdığını dile getirdi. Gençlerin ücret ve çalışma süresiyle, mobbing ve tacizle karşı karşıya kaldığını aktardı. TBMM lokantasında stajyer olarak çalışan kız çocuklarının Meclis personeli tarafından taciz edildiği ortaya çıkmış, haklarında 16 yıl 6 aya kadar hapis cezası istenen 4’ü tutuklu 5 sanığın davasında mahkeme, tutuklu sanıkların tahliyelerine karar vermişti.

2026 verilerine göre gastronomi ve mutfak sanatları bölümlerinin taban puanları yükseldi. Özyeğin Üniversitesi İngilizce burslu programı 460.30 puan ve 1178 başarı sırasıyla ilk sırada yer aldı. Devlet üniversitelerinde ise Akdeniz Üniversitesi 403.18, (10 bin 885 başarı sırası), Anadolu Üniversitesi 393.77 (15 bin 613 başarı sırası), Eskişehir Osmangazi Üniversitesi 381.53 (24 bin 225 başarı sırası) puanla öğrenci kabul etti.

Kendisi de aşçı olarak çalışan DİSK’e bağlı Dev Turizm-İş Genel Başkanı Turgay Özdemir, “Tamamen insan bedeni ve insan emeğiyle üretilen, insan emeğinin artı değere çevrildiği bir iş kolu bizim iş kolumuz. Çok uzun çalışma saatlerinin, yorucu ve atmosferik ortamın sıcaklığın, çalışma koşulları ve mevcut çalışma yerlerinin iyileştirilmemesiyle ilgili ciddi bir problem var. O şaşaalı, büyük otellerin görünmeyen alanlardaki dinlenme alanları ya yok ya da aynı standartta değil. Aşçıların mola yapabileceği, çay içebileceği bir alan yok çoğu işletmede, işçi sağlığı öncelenmiyor” dedi.

Catering sektöründe çalışan Aşçı Başaran benzer bir tabloyu yemek üretiminin yoğunluğu üzerinden anlattı. Catering mutfaklarını “inşaat şantiyesi”ne benzeten Başaran “Burada inşaat işçisi gibisin, öyle bir tabak iki tabak ya da on kişilik, yirmi kişilik yapmıyorsun; burada yaptığın zaman en düşük yaptığın yer 2 bin kişilik, 3 bin kişilik” dedi. Mutfak işçisinin işinin yemek pişirmekle sınırlı kalmadığını, taşıma, indirme, kaldırma ve yükleme gibi işlerin de aşçılara yaptırıldığını anlatan Başaran, mutfaklarda çalışanların kendilerine ayrılmış bir dinlenme alanı dahi olmadığını dile getirdi: “Koridorda bir yer bulursa ya da beş-on dakika dışarı çıkıp hava alabilirse dinleniyor. Başka türlü yok.”

Binlerce kişiye yemek üreten mutfaklarda yoğunluk, işçinin yalnızca iş yerinde geçirdiği süreyi değil, işe ulaşım için harcadığı zamanı da artırıyor. Evden çıkıp eve dönene kadar geçen sürenin 16 saate ulaşabildiğini belirten bir diğer aşçı, “Sabah 5.20’de servise bindim, 5 çeyrek gibi evden çıktım, işe saat 07.00’de başlıyorum, 15.00’te iş bitiyor, fazla mesai başlıyor ve düşünmeye başlıyorum şu an geri eve ne zaman döneceğim. Akşam 9’da evde oluyorum. Çoğu zaman uykudan uykuya gidiyorum eve” dedi.

Yemeğin zamanında yetiştirilmesi, beğenilmesi ve belirlenen maliyet içerisinde hazırlanması da çalışanların üzerindeki baskıyı artırıyor. Başaran, “En ucuz malzemeyle en iyi yemeği çıkarmamızı istiyorlar” diye anlatıyor bu durumu.

Catering sektöründe çalışan bir başka aşçı ise personel için hazırlanan yemeklerin çoğu zaman üretimde kullanılan ürünlerden farklı olduğunu, protein yerine karbonhidrat …

title: Four Kurdish citizens remain detained in Iran, whereabouts unknown
content:
Four Kurdish citizens arrested by security forces in Bukan, Miandoab and Piranshahr in West Azerbaijan Province between 2 and 4 November remain detained with their exact whereabouts and condition unknown.


The detainees – Diyar Abroun, Jamileh (Mina) Mohammadamin-Azar, Saadi Karimi, and Mahmoud Pileh – have been denied access to legal counsel and family visits since their arrests.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has learned that security forces violently arrested Abroun, from Piranshahr, on 2 November.


On 3 November, Ministry of Intelligence forces raided Mohammadamin-Azar’s family home in Bukan and arrested her and her husband, Khoshnaw Azizpour, without a warrant.


Azizpour was released after several hours of interrogation, while Mohammadamin-Azar was reportedly transferred to a security detention facility in Orumiyeh, the provincial capital, with her exact place of detention remaining unknown.


Security forces also arrested Karimi, another citizen from Bukan, on the same day.


On 4 November, security forces arrested Pileh, from the village of Gug Jalu in Miandoab County.

title: Eğitim Sen Bolu'dan öğretmen görevlendirmelerine tepki: Hatalı atamalar gözden geçirilsin
content:
Eğitim Sen Bolu Şubesi, norm kadro fazlası öğretmenlere yönelik resen atama kararlarına ve il genelindeki hatalı görevlendirmelere tepki gösterdi. Öğretmenlerin kendi branşları dışında görevlendirilmesine, rehber öğretmenlerin ikinci okullarda çalıştırılmasına ve sınıfların birleştirilmesine dikkat çeken sendika, Millî Eğitim Bakanlığına uygulamaları gözden geçirme çağrısı yaptı.

Eğitim Sen Bolu Şubesi, il genelinde norm kadro fazlası öğretmenlere yönelik uygulamalar ve öğretmen görevlendirmelerinde yaşanan sorunlara ilişkin açıklama yaptı. Şube Yürütme Kurulu adına açıklamayı yapan Şube Başkanı Dilek Çakman, Millî Eğitim Bakanlığını (MEB) resen atama kararlarını ve hatalı görevlendirmeleri gözden geçirmeye çağırdı.

Açıklamada, norm kadro uygulamaları, plansız atamalar ve okul dönüşümlerinin öğretmenler ile öğrencileri mağdur ettiği belirtildi. Okulların birleştirilmesi ve kapatılması sonucunda çok sayıda öğretmenin görev yaptığı okulda norm kadro fazlası durumuna düşürüldüğünü ifade eden Çakman, ders çizelgelerindeki değişikliklerin, okul dönüşümlerinin ve istihdam politikalarının sonuçlarının öğretmenlere yüklenmesine tepki gösterdi.

Açıklamada, şubelerin birleştirilmesiyle sınıf mevcutlarının arttığına, ikili eğitimin yaygınlaştığına ve öğretmen değişikliklerinin eğitimde sürekliliği olumsuz etkilediğine dikkat çekildi.

Sınıflara ilişkin kararların yalnızca öğrenci sayısı ve bina kapasitesi dikkate alınarak değil, öğrencilerin öğrenme ihtiyaçları ve pedagojik koşullar gözetilerek alınması gerektiği vurgulandı. Eğitimde verimliliğin sınıf mevcutlarının azaltılması ve her öğrencinin eşit, kamusal ve nitelikli eğitime erişiminin sağlanmasıyla mümkün olabileceği belirtildi.

MEB'in 19 Ağustos 2026 tarihli 2026/70 sayılı Genelgesi kapsamında norm kadro fazlası öğretmenlerin belirli bir takvime bağlı kalmaksızın ihtiyaç bulunan okullara atanmasının öngörüldüğünü hatırlatan Eğitim Sen Bolu Şubesi, uygulamanın öğretmenler açısından belirsizliği artırdığını savundu.

Öğretmenlerin eğitim aldıkları branşlar dışında görevlendirilmesine de tepki gösteren sendika, öğretmen açığının kadrolu atamalarla giderilmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.

Çakman, Bolu genelinde norm kadro fazlası öğretmenlere yönelik hatalı görevlendirmeler yapıldığını belirtti. Açıklamada, öğretmenlerin kendi alanları dışında görevlendirilmesi, rehber öğretmenlerin ilgili genelgeye aykırı biçimde ikinci okullarda görevlendirilmesi ve destek eğitiminde öğretmen görevlendirmelerine ilişkin ortak bir standardın bulunmaması eleştirildi.

İl Millî Eğitim Müdürlüğünün ilgili birimleriyle yapılan görüşmelere rağmen sorunların çözümü için somut bir adım atılmadığını savunan sendika, öğrencilerin üstün yararını gözeten kesintisiz ve nitelikli bir eğitim için öğretmenlerin güvenli ve istikrarlı çalışma koşullarına sahip olması gerektiğini kaydetti.

Açıklamanın sonunda norm kadro fazlası sorununun sorumlusunun öğretmenler olmadığı vurgulandı. Eğitim Sen Bolu Şubesi, resen atama kararlarının ve hatalı görevlendirmelerin derhâl gözden geçirilmesini, norm kadro planlamasının okulların gerçek ihtiyaçları ve öğrencilerin üstün yararı doğrultusunda yapılmasını istedi.

Eğitim politikalarının kamusal, bilimsel ve pedagojik ilkeler doğrultusunda yürütülmesi gerektiğini belirten sendika, norm kadro fazlası ilan edilerek görev yerleri değiştirilen öğretmenlerle dayanışmayı sürdüreceğini ve yaşanan mağduriyetler giderilene kadar mücadele edeceğini duyurdu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: EMEP Bursa Kongresi'nde birleşik mücadele çağrısı: Genel eylem, genel halk direnişi
content:
Emek Partisi Bursa İl Örgütü 11. Olağan Kongresi’nde konuşan EMEP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı İstanbul Milletvekili İskender Bayhan’ın katılımıyla gerçekleştirildi.

Emek Partisi (EMEP) Bursa İl Örgütü 11. Olağan Kongresi, Merinos Atatürk Kongre Kültür Merkezi’nde gerçekleştirildi. Kongreye EMEP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı İstanbul Milletvekili İskender Bayhan’ın yanı sıra siyasi parti ve sendika temsilcileri katıldı. Kongreye Taymes Tekstil’de patron şiddetine maruz kalan kadın işçi ve Korteks fabrikasında TEKSİF’in satış sözleşmesine karşı çıktıkları için işten atılan tekstil işçileri katılarak bir konuşma yaptı.

Kongreye ayrıca metal, gıda, tekstil iş kolları olmak üzere farklı sektörde çalışan işçiler de katıldı.

Kongrede konuşan EMEP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı İstanbul Milletvekili İskender Bayhan, dünyada yaşanan son gelişmelere değinerek, “Bütün dünyada egemen olan sermaye düzeni ne yazık ki bütün dünya halklarını yeni ve daha büyük savaşlara sürükleyecek olan iktisadi ve politik programlar uyguluyorlar. Bütün dünyada savaş ve sömürü politikası büyüdükçe halkların mücadelesi de büyüyor” dedi.

Sarayda oturan bir avuç sermayedar ve oligarşinin temsilcileri, var olan savaş politikalarının içinde aktif olarak yer alıp buradan pay almalıyız yaklaşımında olduğunu söyleyen Bayhan, “Bölge politikaları bize savaşsız bir bölge değil, savaşın bölgede yayılması ve oradan pay kapmaya dönük. Mekke anlaşması da bu zincirin bir halkasıdır. Onların gözünde bu ülkenin işçilerinin, emekçilerinin mutlak yoksullaşması, gençlerin geleceğinin olmaması önemli değil. Onlar için tek önemli olan bu coğrafyada yeniden paylaşımdan güçlü bir pozisyon alıp yüksek kârlarla, rantlarla bu yeniden paylaşımdan çıkmak.”

Fedakarlık yapın, dişinizi sıkın diyenler oturdukları yerden milyarları götürüyor diyen Bayhan, “Partimizin yeni anayasa konusundaki tutumu açıktır. Bu parlamentonun ve Cumhur İttifakı'nın bu ülkenin halkının, emekçilerinin çıkarına demokratik bir anayasa yazma ihtimali bir toplu iğnenin ucu kadar yoktur. Böyle bir niyeti de yoktur. Bunu her vesileyle dile getiriyoruz. Seçimler konusuna gelince ise partimizin tutumu açık. Geçmişte saray oligarşisinin son bulması için biz iki seçim üst üste burjuva muhalefetini eleştirmemize, düzen içi muhalefet dememize rağmen destekledik. Önümüzdeki dönem ortak mücadelenin, birleşik mücadelenin temel hedefi bir genel eylem, genel halk direnişi hattı olmalıdır. Seçimlerde bunun parçası olmalıdır. Bu yolu ortak yürüme noktasında hiçbir tereddüdümüz yoktur. Bunun olmamasının sorumlusu kimse de hesap vermeli” dedi.

Kongrede söz alan KESK Bursa Dönem Sözcüsü Eğitim Sen Şube Başkanı Derviş Erdem, “Hem siyasal hem de sendikal mücadeleyi yürütme noktasında zor bir dönemdeyiz. Adalete kimse inanmıyor. Siz kimi seçerseniz seçin, ben istediğimle yol yürüyeceğim diyen bir iktidar var. Doğa her gün talan ediliyor. Eğitimde parası olmayan nitelikli bir eğitim alamaz duruma geldi. Sağlıkta durum aynı. Bizden toplanan 100 liralık vergiden 20 lirası faize gidiyor, yüzde 17’si silahlanmaya ve yüzde 5’i de asla bizim kadar vergi vermeyen, devletten ballı ihaleler alan ve vergi borçları silinen o büyük şirketlere teşvik olarak veriliyor. Siyasi iktidar tercihini asla işçiden emekçiden yana kullanmıyor” dedi.

AKP’nin iktidara geldiği günden bugüne mücadeleci örgütleri ele geçirdiğini söyleyen Birleşik Metal Bursa Şube Başkanı Gökhan Aydın, “İşçilerin mücadeleleri iktidarın desteği ile sarı sendikalar tarafından bastırıldı. Bugün bütçe görüşmeleri var ve asgari ücretin düşük kalması için çalışmalar yapılırken vergi dilimleriyle soyuluyoruz. DİSK’e bağlı 11 sendika 29 Kasım'da İstanbul’da bir miting gerçekleştireceğiz. Lokal eylemler oluyor, bunlar önemli ama orada bırakmamak gerekir. Güç biriktirerek sorunların üstesinden gelmemiz gerekiyor” dedi.

Taymes Tekstil’de sendikaya üye olduğu için patron tarafından baskı ve şiddete maruz kalan kadın işçi ise konuşmasında şunları söyledi: “Sendikaya üye olma hakkımı kullandığım için patron ve çocukları tarafından sürekli mobbinge maruz bırakıldım. Bahane olarak çalışma arkadaşlarımı yasal ve meşru haklarını kullanmaya çağırmam gösterildi. Biz işçilerin hakları sadece kağıt üzerinde mi yazılı kalacak? title: Kocaeli Şehir Tiyatroları’nın kurucu sanatçılarından Şafak Karali hayatını kaybetti
content:
Kocaeli Büyükşehir Belediyesi Şehir Tiyatroları’nın kurucu sanatçıları arasında yer alan tiyatro oyuncusu Şafak Karali, 57 yaşında yaşamını yitirdi. Nuri Bilge Ceylan’ın “Bir Zamanlar Anadolu’da” filmi ile “Avrupa Yakası”, “Leyla ile Mecnun” ve “Karadayı” gibi yapımlarda da rol alan Karali için 9 Kasım’da anma töreni düzenlenecek.

Kocaeli Büyükşehir Belediyesi Şehir Tiyatroları’nın kurucu sanatçılarından tiyatro oyuncusu Şafak Karali, 57 yaşında hayatını kaybetti. Karali’nin vefat haberi, Kocaeli Şehir Tiyatroları’nın resmi sosyal medya hesaplarından duyuruldu.

Tiyatro sahnesindeki çalışmalarının yanı sıra sinema ve televizyon projelerinde de rol alan Karali, Nuri Bilge Ceylan’ın yönettiği “Bir Zamanlar Anadolu’da” filminde ve “Avrupa Yakası”, “Leyla ile Mecnun” ve “Karadayı” dizilerinde izleyici karşısına çıktı.

Şafak Karali için 9 Kasım Pazartesi günü saat 10.00’da Süleyman Demirel Kültür Merkezi’nde (SDKM) anma töreni düzenlenecek.

Karali’nin cenazesi, törenin ardından öğle namazını müteakip İzmit Yahya Kaptan Akşemsettin Camii’nde kılınacak cenaze namazının ardından defnedilecek.

title: Yıldız Çakar’s poetry wins international award in the US
content:
The poem “Mohra Reş” (The Dark Seal) by Kurdish poet and novelist Yıldız Çakar has won the Special International Honorable Mention at the Julia Vive Feminist Poetry Festival, held in Philadelphia, USA. The award, presented in the category of “Poetry, Memory and Resistance,” recognizes Çakar’s distinctive literary treatment of women’s struggle, collective memory and resistance.


Organized by the Madre Tierra Women’s Center (CIMMT), the Julia Vive Feminist Poetry Festival will take place on November 13 at the Taller Puertorriqueño Cultural Center in Philadelphia. Bringing together 100 poets from different parts of the world, the festival selected Yıldız Çakar’s poem “Mohra Reş” (The Dark Seal) for the Special International Honorable Mention in the “Poetry, Memory and Resistance” category.


The award committee informed Yıldız Çakar of its decision in a special letter. Highlighting the poet’s literary strength, the letter noted that she explores themes including violence against women, femicide, collective memory, land, loss and women’s resistance through a distinctive Kurdish perspective.


The letter also emphasized that Çakar’s poem expands the festival’s literary horizons beyond Latin America and the Caribbean, giving it a global dimension. It highlighted the work’s powerful connection to women’s struggles for freedom and dignity.


As one of the festival’s participants living outside the United States, Yıldız Çakar will have her poem presented to audiences through a video recording during the official award ceremony.


10 books published


Yıldız Çakar, who has worked in journalism and literature for many years, has published 10 books across the genres of poetry, fiction and research. Her first poetry collection, “Goristana Stêrkan,” was published in 2004.


Her book “Mohra Reş,” which contains the poem selected for the award, was published in 2024. The collection’s central poem was later adapted into a digital theatre project titled “Lockedown Locked In.” The project won the Best Original Screenplay award at the Athens International Art Films Festival.


In her work, Yıldız Çakar focuses primarily on themes of death, exile, identity and oppression. Rather than relying on conventional poetic forms, her style draws on profound expression and the oral memory of Kurdish history.


Yıldız Çakar, who migrated to Germany in 2018 and has lived in Berlin for the past eight years, was detained at Istanbul Airport in May of this year while traveling to Turkey. She was released after being questioned.

title: Koma Berxwedan: Release Nûdem Durak and ill prisoners
content:
Members of Koma Berxwedan and other artists issued a statement to draw attention to the situation of Kurdish artist Nûdem Durak, who has been in prison for 11.5 years and is reportedly battling serious illnesses.


Reacting to the 19-year-and-6-month prison sentence handed down to Nûdem Durak, the artists said that her health had deteriorated and that her life was in danger. They called for the release of all sick prisoners, particularly Nûdem Durak.


Criticising the continued imprisonment of sick prisoners at a time when the Peace and Democratic Society Process is being discussed, the artists called on human rights organisations, intellectuals, politicians and the public to intensify their efforts and raise their voices.


 


Freedom of ill prisoners must be our top priority


Speaking on behalf of Koma Berxwedan, Hekim Sefkan said that, at a time when hopes for peace were growing, decisions continued to be made that contradicted human rights and the spirit of the process. Reacting to the prison sentence imposed on Nûdem Durak, Sefkan said it was unacceptable that the artist was being kept behind bars despite her serious health problems.


Sefkan said: “At a time when hopes for peace are growing, decisions and actions that contradict human rights and the spirit of the process are also continuing. One such decision is the 19.5-year prison sentence imposed on artist Nûdem Durak. She has been in prison for 11.5 years. She is ill. Keeping her in prison for another 19.5 years at such a time goes against both the spirit of the process and human rights.


We call on all intellectuals, artists, human rights defenders and our people to raise their voices against this injustice. We want people to take a stand against this unlawful treatment, to speak out for all sick prisoners, and to make this our number one priority. All ill prisoners, beginning with our artist Nûdem Durak, must be released as soon as possible so that they can continue their treatment in humane conditions. On this issue, we call on everyone, particularly human rights organisations, to increase pressure on the state institutions responsible for these decisions. All relevant institutions must intensify their struggle against these decisions, which disregard human rights.”


The peace process is, above all, a test of sincerity


Artist Seyda Perinçek also criticised the prison sentence imposed on Nûdem Durak, drawing attention to the increasingly serious health conditions of sick prisoners. Stating that the release of sick prisoners would be an important step in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, Perinçek emphasised that the state must take concrete action on this matter.


Perinçek said: “The condition of sick prisoners is becoming increasingly serious. One of them is artist Nûdem Durak who has been in prison for 11.5 years because of her work for Kurdish art and Kurdish culture. She is trying to survive under extremely difficult conditions while battling illness.


We must struggle for all sick prisoners, with Nûdem as a particular example. We must take a stand against this torture and this inhumane situation, because our friends are being left to die in prison. The peace process is, above all, a test of sincerity. Addressing the situation of sick prisoners must be the starting point for demonstrating good faith. In particular, our friends who are ill and have been imprisoned for many years must be released.”


Nûdem is in prison for her dedication to Kurdish culture and art


Bermal Çem, speaking on behalf of Hünera Mizgîn, said that Nûdem Durak had been punished for her contributions to Kurdish culture and art. Çem said that Durak had been held in prison for years and was struggling with serious health problems. She added that her illness was progressing and that she was at risk of losing her voice. Emphasising that the situation of sick prisoners is not merely a concern for their families and loved ones, but a matter for society as a whole, Çem appealed to intellectuals, human rights defenders and politicians.


Çem added: “Nûdem was arrested despite being innocent and has been held in prison for years. Her only ‘crime’ was contributing to Kurdish culture and art and keeping them alive. Today, she is fighting for her life in prison while suffering from cancer. Despite this serious illness, she was sentenced to 19.5 years in prison. Her condition is deteriorating, and she could even lose her voice.

title: Akın: Policies destroying nature and society must end for ecological peace
content:
The Conference of the Parties (COP), held annually under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) to combat climate change, brings together countries from around the world. The 31st conference (COP31), which will address critical issues such as climate finance, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and the energy transition, will take place in Antalya from 9 to 20 November 2026.


However, the deepening ecological crisis despite nearly 30 years of conferences has reignited debate over the role of these summits in combating climate change. Ecologists are questioning whether these meetings offer genuine solutions for protecting nature and the climate.


Ibrahim Akın, Co-Deputy Chair of the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) responsible for Ecology and Agriculture, spoke about the importance of ecological peace in the context of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the background of the summit and the People's Climate Summit, which has emerged as an alternative gathering ahead of COP31.


'Ecological destruction impoverishes and displaces peoples'


Ibrahim Akın defined ecological peace as restoring balance in the relationship between humanity and nature and freeing nature and living environments from exploitation. He drew attention to the impact of ecological destruction on peoples and said: "Under capitalism, nature has been transformed into a source of capital accumulation. Our land, water and air have been turned into commodities. The exploitation of nature has been added to the exploitation of labor. Peoples who resist this plunder have often been confronted by state security forces, the judiciary and mechanisms of repression. Therefore, attacks on nature do not merely cause ecological destruction. They also impoverish peoples, displace them and sever their ties with their history and culture. In this respect, ecological destruction is part of the war being waged against the people."


'

Ecocide is also a devastating attack on the future of societies'


Akın said that ecological peace carries a meaning beyond the silencing of weapons in the context of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, emphasizing that it requires an end to policies that destroy nature and society. He continued: "Social peace cannot be achieved without guaranteeing peoples' right to have a say and make decisions over their lands, waters and living environments. To achieve this, the commodification of nature must end, the will of local communities must be recognized and acts of ecocide must be stopped. Ecocide is a devastating attack not only on nature but also on the future of societies that live in harmony with it. A system that continues to wage war against nature cannot promise genuine peace to humanity.


Ecological peace means taking steps to heal nature wounded by war and enabling humanity and nature to establish an egalitarian, free and sustainable relationship."


'The deepening ecological destruction despite more than 30 years of summits is no coincidence'


Ibrahim Akın said that the deepening ecological destruction, despite more than 30 years of summits, signed agreements and announced targets, was no coincidence. He explained the reasons as follows: "This is because the climate crisis is the product of a capitalist system of production and consumption that regards nature as an unlimited reservoir of raw materials, labor as a cheap input for production and every aspect of life as a source of profit. We cannot overcome this crisis by relying solely on technological solutions, carbon markets and international commitments without questioning capital's need for unlimited growth or confronting the interests of fossil fuel companies and major monopolies.


This does not, of course, mean that international cooperation or COP summits are unimportant. However, we must also acknowledge the limitations of these platforms, whose interests they serve and what their decisions actually change in real life. Nevertheless, I see COP summits as platforms that make it possible to bring the climate crisis onto the international agenda."


Turkey's insincere and contradictory approach


Akın drew attention to what he described as Turkey's insincere approach to preparations for COP31, saying that the summit was being treated as an international promotional event rather than an opportunity to confront the root causes of the climate crisis.
