author: groundxero
title: Bernie Sanders: Winning the Midterms Is Not Enough. Here’s What We Must Do
content:
The American people understand that the economy today is rigged and that we cannot continue the ‘same old, same old’ establishment politics and establishment policies.


 


Bernie Sanders


Nov 05, 2026


Common Dreams


 


On Tuesday, Trump told us to vote as if he were on the ballot. And that is exactly what the American people did.


 


Together, we stood up to

authoritarianism

 and a president who does not believe in the Constitution or the

rule of law

. And we won.


 


With Democratic control over the Senate and the House, we will now—finally—be able to hold

Donald Trump

 accountable.


 


The American people have had enough. They are demanding real change and bold policies that will dramatically improve their lives.


 


That is a big deal. But as important as it is, it is not enough. We have got to do more.


 


Whether we like it or not, we are living in an unprecedented moment in American history where our country faces extraordinary crises. We cannot and must not run away from them when Democrats assume power in January.


 


These crises must be dealt with.


 


It is no secret that in the

United States

 and all over the world, people are giving up on

democracy

. Now, why is that?


 


And the answer is that—all over the world, not just in America—working families are struggling to put food on the table and pay for basic necessities while the very richest people become much richer. And, throughout our country and in many other countries, ordinary people are saying, ‘Does their government even know that they exist?’ Or are elected officials too busy worrying about the needs of the rich and the powerful?


 


This is an American issue, but, in fact, an international issue.


 


And in my view, the American people have had enough. They are demanding real change and bold policies that will dramatically improve their lives.


 


In the richest country on Earth, the American people want a government that stands for working families, not billionaire campaign contributors. And that is not just

Bernie Sanders

 talking.


 


According to a recent AP poll, 80% of registered voters want either “complete and total upheaval” or “substantial change” in how this country is run. And that includes 97% of Democrats, 90% of independents, and 58% of

Republicans

.


 


In other words, the American people understand that the economy today is rigged and that we cannot continue the ‘same old, same old’ establishment politics and establishment policies.


 


The American people want change. Real change. And the midterm election confirms just that.


 


Let me give you some examples of what I mean and the issues that we have got to deal with.


 


In our country today, income and

wealth inequality

 has reached unprecedented levels. The top 1% now owns more wealth than the bottom 93%. One man,

Elon Musk

, owns more wealth than the bottom 53% of American households. In my view, that is insane. And I think that’s how most Americans feel.


 


Democrats, when they gain control, in January, of the House and the Senate, cannot ignore this grotesque

inequality

. We must take on the greed of the very, very rich and their incredible wealth.


 


We must enact a 5% wealth tax on billionaires so that we can provide every working-class family in the country, a family of four, with a $12,000 direct payment.


 


And that means a Democratic Congress must pass a wealth tax on billionaires.


 


At a time when billionaires pay a lower effective tax rate than truck drivers or nurses, we must enact a 5% wealth tax on billionaires so that we can provide every working-class family in the country, a family of four, with a $12,000 direct payment. In other words, if you’re a working-class family of four, that’s $3,000 for every man, woman, and child—$12,000.


 


Furthermore, with that tax on billionaires, we can build 7 million units of low-income and

affordable housing

, we can make public colleges and universities tuition-free, and we can provide universal free child care for 13 million

children

. That is what a wealth tax on billionaires can do.


 


But taxing the oligarchs means more than just taking on their wealth.

It means ending their stranglehold over our political system.


 


Elon Musk

 and his billionaire friends have poured a record-breaking $2 billion into the recent election. That is absurd.


 


The American people want Congress to overturn

Citizens United

, abolish

super PACs …

content:
Author

: anonymous

Title

: Adventures in the Terrible Beauty of Resistance

Subtitle

: An interview by Millennials are Killing Capitalism

Date

: 29/09/2026

Source

: https://millennialsarekillingcapitalism.libsyn.com/adventures-in-the-terrible-beauty-of-resistance-with-the-death-to-toll-campaign


Welcome to Millennials Are Killing Capitalism. This is Jay. In this episode we had the rare opportunity to interview a spokesperson from a direct action group that has targeted Toll Holdings, in australia. The campaign has engaged in a range of sabotage, vandalism, and disruptive actions, including sledgehammering windows, cutting internet cables, blockading roads and in an international port entrance, they have also slashed lines and cut valves to disable vehicles, covered facilities inside and out with paint and foul liquids, and sabotaged infrastructure such as signal boxes used by Toll. In this discussion we asked them about the development of the antizionist movement in australia after October 7

th


2023, and asked about how their group settled on its target, prepared their campaign, and selected the tactics they wanted to use in it. As our guest raises the spirit of adventure they see as necessary to take meaningful direct action to confront the genocidal war machine, I also asked them what they think about allegations of adventurism that can be levied from the left at those who take such action. Because this campaign is heavily under threat by the State, we agreed to some additional security measures in this conversation. The voice you hear is not the actual voice of the person we interviewed; the original interview was transcribed and then converted to audio using text-to-voice generator. Just as an editorial disclaimer from me amid heightened attacks on various forms of speech, I just want to say as a platform we are not advocating that people engage in any form of illegal activity. Having said that we do understand the greatest crime that humanity has recognized, the crime of genocide, is still ongoing. There are moral, ethical, and even legal imperatives that people are engaging in order to try to stop that crime from continuing to unfold. This interview is to hear from those who are taking direct action to hold genocide and War crimes. These actions have been threatened with severe repression, and many who take these forms of action do face repression. We see it as a journalistic responsibility to ensure that people hear from those who are willing to take action to stop genocide. We know that their voices will be marginalized by most media platforms out there. It is also very important that people show up and support political prisoners if we are ever to build a movement that is capable of confronting the machinery of genocide and imperialism. We will include links to the Death to Toll campaign website, and other interviews with their spokespeople in the show description.


First of all welcome to Millennials are Killing Capitalism, it’s great that we are able to do this interview to talk about the work that you’re doing in so-called australia, or that region in the world. It’s not an area that we get to cover as often as we should, and that’s typical of us US-brained people that you know, we tend to be quite US-centric. Or maybe focusing on areas like Palestine, and Iran, and Lebanon, where we’ve seen some of the hot elements of this war in its most direct forms. But we do want to highlight different ways that people in different places are resisting the genocide of Palestinians, and this broader campaign to undermine the sovereignty of the entire West Asian region as we see it. And your campaign is one that was brought to my attention by some friends of the platform. And it’s really important that people are able to hear from you.


 A: Thanks so much. Really happy to be here.


So to start, could you talk a little bit about the anti-zionist or pro-Palestine movement in so-called australia. Obviously I’m saying so-called because like the United States, Australia is another settler colony historically. Give me some of the lay of the land, what that has looked like over the last however many years you want — and share what inspired this campaign we are discussing today.


 A: Yeah, so there’s obviously been activism in solidarity with Palestine for a long time in Australia, but I would say that post-Al Aqsa Flood, there was this moment of intensity where, for a minute, it felt like everything changed …

author: CNT Villaverde Alto - Comarcal Sur de Madrid
title: 7 de noviembre: De la Huelga Indefinida a la Huelga General
content:
El próximo

7 de noviembre

, Villaverde se convertirá en el punto de encuentro de las luchas que nos llevan atravesando estas semanas. A través del barrio, caminaremos de la Huelga Indefinida a la Huelga General de la mano de compañeras y amigas.


Arrancaremos el día, a las

12:30

, de la mano del Comité de Huelga de Villaverde, el

espacio unitario

 en el que vecinas y organizaciones de la zona estamos trabajando desde el común para construir la Huelga General del 11, con un pasacalles que recorrerá el barrio,

partiendo del parque El Cruce para llegar a la Plaza de Ágata

, justo en frente del Ateneo Libertario de Villaverde.


Será allí, en la que es nuestra casa, donde el Sindicato abrirá sus puertas para continuar con la jornada. A las

15:00

, la

Sección Sindical de CNT Educación Pública CAM

 habrá preparado una gran paellada popular, con el objetivo de

destinar sus beneficios a la caja de resistencia

 que sostiene su Huelga Indefinida. Y es que, precisamente, de esta lucha histórica emprendida ya hace cuatro semanas nos hablarán también las compañeras aprovechando el espacio colectivo: las que comen juntas, conspiran juntas. Será la oportunidad para aprender, de primera mano, acerca de la experiencia de organización colectiva y desde la base, de lucha y resistencia que están llevando a cabo las compañeras.


Después, extenderemos el hilo colectivo que en la jornada conectará la Huelga Indefinida con la Huelga General para continuar construyendo entre todas una jornada verdaderamente combativa para pararlo todo. Las compas del Comité de Huelga de Villaverde organizarán, a las

17:00

, también en el Ateneo Libertario de Villaverde, un

taller de pancartas

 con el que extender la agitación del 11N.


Y, tras esto, como broche de oro, cerraremos las jornadas con una fiesta a cargo de la

Plataforma Queremos FP

, otra de las organizaciones convocantes de la Huelga Indefinida de Educación en la CAM en la que nuestro Sindicato tiene representación. Las compañeras de FP organizarán una

pinchada de DJ a partir de las 19:00

, acompañada de

bebida y picoteo

 con el objetivo de seguir reforzando la herramienta de lucha que es la caja de resistencia.


Con estas jornadas, CNT Comarcal Sur y las organizaciones convocantes aspiramos a

tejer un espacio colectivo

 que estreche lazos entre las luchas que estamos emprendiendo. Esperamos que se conviertan en un momento de trabajo y de ocio militante, de acumulación de fuerzas para las convocatorias inminentes, así como de refuerzo para las que ya están en marcha.

Esperamos contar con vecinas, afiliadas, militantes y amigas

; extender la voz y la agitación para salir aún más fortalecidas.


Porque sola no puedes, pero con compañeras sí. El próximo 7 de noviembre nos encontraremos con la convicción de que

vamos a ganar la Huelga Indefinida

 y con la determinación de que

el 11N se convierta en un día histórico

 para la lucha de nuestra clase.


¡Que no falte nadie!

7 de noviembre: De la Huelga Indefinida a la Huelga General

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

title: Octubre y noviembre. Visitas guiadas en el 90 aniversario de la Revolución Social
content:
Dentro de la programación que CNT Madrid y el grupo Albatros de la FAI han preparado para conmemorar el 90 aniversario de la Revolución Social existen cuatro salidas muy interesantes centradas en la resistencia al fascismo. Por eso mismo animamos a toda la afiliación de la Regional Centro de CNT a participar en las mismas.


Para resolver dudas o apuntaros debéis escribir a la Secretaría de Acción Social de la CNT de Madrid en

social@madrid.cnt.es.


Tras el rastro de Cipriano Mera: el legado libertario del IV Cuerpo de Ejército en Guadalajara


La primera de estas visitas será a Guadalajara, para lo que fletamos un autobús de 55 plazas desde Madrid. Viajaremos con especialistas y expertas, como un guía especializado en Guerra Civil española y patrimonio. Subiremos al cerro de Montarrón para visitar el arte de trincheras de la 50 Brigada Mixta y haremos un paseo con paradas explicativas por el complejo militar «Casa del Guarda», además de una visita guiada por Brihuega. La comida será de traje.

author: CNT Colmenar Viejo
title: 8 de noviembre. Cuando Sale el Sol
content:
Ópera prima de nuestra compañera Elena Martínez, se

preestreno en el Centro de Humanidades en el municipio de la Cabrera

 los días 8 y 9 de enero de 2016 como homenaje a la sierra de Madrid y posteriormente se

estrenó en Madrid

 en el marco del

Festival Ellas Crean

. Cuando Sale el Sol es un documental colaborativo sobre la dramática realidad de los desahucios.


Durante su recorrido entre 2016 y 2017, fue seleccionado en círculos alternativos como el Teatro del Barrio, en Alternativa Film Festival de Medellín y en el Festival de Málaga fuera de la selección oficial, además de distintos municipios de la sierra norte de Madrid.


Entre los años 2008 y 2014 se produjeron en España más de 500.000 desalojos. En un contexto social de casi cinco millones de personas sin trabajo, las Plataformas de Afectados por la Hipoteca, el movimiento 15M y la propia sociedad civil, consiguieron parar numerosos desahucios y organizar alternativas reales de cambio.


Cuando Sale el Sol pone el acento en las emociones y la lucha de personas y colectivos, traduciéndose en un documental colectivo que construye utopías y rinde homenaje a la solidaridad y al apoyo mutuo. Es también la suma de las miradas de periodistas independientes cuyo trabajo libre y honesto defiende la libertad de expresión, el derecho a la información y a una vivienda digna para todas.


Este próximo

domingo 8 de noviembre

, asistiremos a la

concentración organizada por la PAH SN (Plataforma de Afectadas de la Sierra Norte de Madrid)

 convocada

a las 12 h en la Plaza del Pueblo de Colmenar Viejo

.


Después nos vamos a  juntar

en el local del sindicato CNT Colmenar Viejo a las 14:30 h para una comida popular (apúntate escribiendo a

colmenarviejo@cnt.es

 antes del viernes), y sobre las 17 h se proyectará el documental


Cuando Sale el Sol.

 Aunque se refiere a los desahucios de hipoteca de la época, sigue estando por desgracia de rabiosa actualidad siendo un grito por el derecho a la vivienda, señalando la increíble herramienta que supone la solidaridad y el apoyo mutuo para conquistar imposibles.

author: Unknown
title: Ji ber nûçeya girtina rojnameger Yelis Ayazê, li dijî bianetê lêpirsîn hat vekirin
content:
Rêvebirê Karên Nivîsan ê Berpirsiyar ê bianetê Vecih Cuzdan, ji ber nûçeya ku di 18ê Gulana 2026an de li ser girtina rojnamevan Yelis Ayazê hatibû weşandin, di çarçoveya lêpirsîna ku ji aliyê Serdozgeriya Komarê ya Aydinê ve tê meşandin de duh li Stenbolê îfade da.


Lêpirsîn li ser giliya Parlementera AKPê ya Aydinê Seda Saribaşê hatiye destpêkirin ku navê wê di nûçeyê de derbas dibû.


Cuzdan tevî parêzera xwe Deniz Yazgan çû Amîriya Buroya Ewlehiyê ya Rêvebiriya Emniyeta Navçeya Maltepeyê.


Cuzdan di çarçoveya xala 217/A ya Qanûna Cezayê Tirkan(TCK) de bi sûcê “

bi zanayî agahiyên xapînok di nav gel de belav kiriye

” û di çarçoveya xala 123an a TCKê de bi sûcê “

aramiya kesan têk daye

” hat tohmetbarkirin.


Hat hînbûn ku di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de dê Rêveberê Giştî ê Weşanê ê bianetê Murat İnceoglu jî îfadeyê bide.


Cuzdan: Nûçe li ser girtina rojnamevanekê ye


Cuzdan sûcdarî qebûl nekirin û diyar kir ku nûçeyê behsa girtina rojnamevan Yelis Ayazê ya ji ber xebatên wê yên rojnamevaniyê û bertekên rêxistinên pîşeyî yên çapemeniyê kiriye:


“Bûyera ku tê îdiakirin di dibistanê de qewimiye, ji bo nîşandayîna ku ev girtin li ser kîjan nûçeyan hatiye girtin, hatiye veguhastin. Di sernavê de bi eşkereyî hatiye gotin ku ev îdiayek e. Di nûçeyê de hem cih daye daxuyaniya Serdozgeriya Komarê ya Aydinê ya ku gotibû îdia ne rast in, hem jî daxuyaniya ku Ayazê ji girtîgehê şandibû.


Têkildarî serlêdanên CÎMERê û wêneyan, hemû agahî bi destnîşankirina çavkaniyên wan hatine veguhastin. Mebesta bingehîn a vê weşanê agahdarkirina civakê ye di barê girtina rojnamevanekê û helwestên li dijî vê girtinê de. Zev e ku mebesta vê nûçeyê ti carî belavkirina tirs, fikar an panîkê di nav civakê de nehatiye meşandin.”


Yazgan: Girtina rojnamevanekê raya giştî eleqedar dike


Parêzerê Cuzdan, Deniz Yazganê jî di îfadeya xwe de diyar kir ku di nûçeyê de vegotina derbarê dibistanê de di sernav û xala destpêkê (spot) de bi awayê “îdia” hatiye nîşandan. Bi bîr xist ku daxuyaniya Serdozgeriya Komarê ya Aydinê ya ku îdiayan red dike jî di nava metnê de cih girtiye.


Yazganê anî ziman ku gotinên di nivîsa Ayazê ya ku ji girtîgehê şandibû de bi eşkereyî ji bo xwe nîvîsiye û got: “Destnîşankirina serlêdanên CÎMERê an jî belavkirina wêneyan nayê wê wateyê ku bûyera li dibistanê hatiye îsbatkirin; ev her du mijar ji hev cuda ne. bianet.orgê tu carî ev îdia wekî rastiyeke ku bi xwe lêkolîn kiriye û derxistiye holê pêşkêş nekiriye.”


Yazgan diyar kir ku heke berevajiyê vê yekê were îdiakirin, divê bê destnîşankirin ka ew îdia dispêre kîjan îfadeya di nûçeyê de:


“Mijara nûçeyê biryara girtinê ye, di nava xwe de daxuyaniya dijber dihewîne û bertekên rêxistinên pîşeyî yên çapemeniyê radigihîne; ev hemû nîşan didin ku ev weşan bi armanca agahdarkirina raya giştî hatiye kirin. Girtina rojnamevanekê ji ber xebatên wê yên nûçegihaniyê û bandora bendeke cezayî ya li ser çapemeniyê, bi xwe re mijarên ku eleqeya wan bi berjewendiya raya giştî re heye tînin.”


Yazganê her wiha daxwaz kir ku bê diyarkirin giliya sûc di kîjan dîrokê de ketiye qeydan. Yazganê heyama çar mehan a vekirina dozê ya ku di maddeya 26an a Qanûna Çapemeniyê de cih digire bi bîr xist. Yazganê diyar kir ku ji bo vekirina doza giştî gumaneke (şubhe) bes tune ye û daxwaz kir ku derbarê Cuzdan de biryara neşopandinê bê dayin.


Mijara nûçeyê girtina Ayazê bû


Nûçeya bianetê ya ku bû mijara lêpirsînê, di 18ê Gulanê de bi sernavê “Rojnamevana ku îdiaya ‘Kurê parlementerê AKPî bi çekê çû dibistanê’ nivîsî sê roj in girtî ye” hatibû weşandin.


Di nûçeyê de hatibû aşkerekirin ku xwediyê Rojnameya Aydinpostê Yelis Ayaz, piştî ku îdiayên derbarê kurê parlementerekî de ku bi çekê çûye dibistanê kiribû nûçe, di çarçoveya xala 217/A ya TCKyê de hatiye girtin.


Di nûçeyê de her wiha cih dabûn wê nivîsa ku Ayazê ji nava girtîgehê nivîsîbû.


(HA/AY)
